title: District spatial baseline
period: 2025 LST and tree cover; May 2020-Dec 2025 watering
metric: Legacy district LST and canopy context; watering reach (%) and litres per inventory tree
limits: LOR metrics are aggregated by district and joined to the 2025 summer rows of data/Berlin_heat_population_death_Birth_data.csv. Reference periods differ; legacy heat provenance is incomplete. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Neighbourhood watering reach and intensity
metric: Distinct-tree reach (%) and recorded litres per inventory tree
limits: Colour scales are capped at the 95th percentile; inspect the table for extreme values. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Exploratory local spatial clusters
metric: Local Moran classes for recorded watering reach
limits: Row-standardised queen contiguity; 999 permutations; unadjusted local p < 0.05, seed 42. Exploratory screening with no multiplicity correction. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Recorded care and social/environmental context
metric: Recorded reach, MSS status, thermal burden and environmental/social burden count
limits: 542 polygons; 535 valid MSS observations with inventoried trees. Static contextual layers are not historical area-level vulnerability. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Areas for further care-gap validation
metric: Low/very-low-status areas with thermal or green need and below-median recorded reach
limits: Screening candidates only, not validated irrigation priorities or the proposed allocation model. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Calendar-month climatology
period: Complete years 2021-2025 pooled by calendar month
metric: Mean monthly events per 1,000 current inventory trees
limits: Five-year calendar-month means include observed zeros. Shared fixed classes; no pooled-month thermal inference. Recorded platform activity only; current-inventory denominators; no inference about unlogged or municipal watering.

title: Active-season comparison across years
metric: Monthly events per 1,000 current inventory trees
